title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Acts 18: Paul at Corinth with Aquila and Priscilla, Gallio's judgment seat, and Apollos at Ephesus.

questions.text: What trade did Paul share with Aquila and Priscilla?
questions.explanation: Because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

answers.text: They were silversmiths
They were sellers of purple
They were fishermen
They were tent makers

questions.text: Why had Aquila recently come from Italy?
questions.explanation: Acts 18:2 says Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome.

answers.text: A great famine had come upon Italy
Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome
The apostles had sent him to Corinth
A plot had been made against his life

questions.text: What did Paul say when they opposed him and blasphemed?
questions.explanation: He shook out his clothing and said that their blood was on their own heads, that he was clean, and that from then on he would go to the Gentiles.

answers.text: Your blood be on your own heads! From now on, I will go to the Gentiles
I will come back to you again if God wills it so, brothers
I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem
Let the courts judge between you and me in this matter

questions.text: Who was the ruler of the synagogue who believed in the Lord with all his house?
questions.explanation: Acts 18:8 says Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house.

answers.text: Sosthenes
Justus
Crispus
Apollos

questions.text: What did the Lord say to Paul in the night by a vision?
questions.explanation: The Lord told him not to be afraid but to speak and not be silent, for the Lord was with him and had many people in that city.

answers.text: Don't be afraid, but speak and don't be silent, for I am with you
Go up to Jerusalem without delay and testify there
Shake off the dust of your feet and leave this city
Sail from here to Syria before the coming feast

questions.text: How long did Paul live there, teaching the word of God among them?
questions.explanation: Acts 18:11 says he lived there a year and six months.

answers.text: Three whole months
Two years and six months
Three years and a half
A year and six months

questions.text: What did Gallio do when the Jews brought Paul before the judgment seat?
questions.explanation: Gallio said that questions about words and names and their own law were for them to settle, and he drove them from the judgment seat.

answers.text: He commanded that Paul should be beaten with rods
He sent Paul away to Caesar at Rome for judgment
He refused to judge the matter and drove them from the judgment seat
He judged for Paul and punished his accusers himself

questions.text: What did Paul do in Cenchreae before sailing for Syria?
questions.explanation: Acts 18:18 says he shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

answers.text: He baptized Priscilla and Aquila there
He shaved his head, for he had a vow
He left Silas and Timothy behind there
He wrote a letter to the brothers

questions.text: What is said about Apollos when he came to Ephesus?
questions.explanation: He was a Jew, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, mighty in the Scriptures, who knew only the baptism of John.

answers.text: He was an eloquent Alexandrian Jew, mighty in the Scriptures
He was a tent maker from Pontus who came from Italy
He was the ruler of the synagogue at Corinth
He was the proconsul of Achaia at that time

questions.text: What did Priscilla and Aquila do when they heard Apollos speaking boldly in the synagogue?
questions.explanation: They took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

answers.text: They sent him up to the apostles in Jerusalem
They rebuked him in front of the synagogue
They took him aside and explained the way of God more accurately
They baptized him in the name of the Lord Jesus
